facts.statement: Phymolepis is an extinct genus of fish.
Phymolepis belongs to the order Antiarchi.
Phymolepis is classified within the class Placodermi.
Phymolepis is a member of the family Yunnanolepididae.
The type species P. cuifengshanensis was named by Zhang Goroui in 1978.
facts.quote: The type species, P. cuifengshanensis, was named by Zhang Goroui in 1978

facts.statement: The holotype was found in the Xitun Formation near Cuifengshan.
facts.quote: and it was found in the Xitun Formation, near Cuifengshan.

facts.statement: Several other specimens of varying completeness have been referred to Phymolepis.
facts.quote: and several other specimens of varying completeness have also been referred to Phymolepis

facts.statement: Some specimens were recovered from the Xishancun Formation.
facts.quote: with some specimens also being recovered from the Xishancun Formation.

facts.statement: Phymolepis lived in China during the Early Devonian.
facts.quote: from the Early Devonian of China

facts.statement: Phymolepis lived between 419.62 and 413.02 million years ago during the Lochkovian stage.
facts.quote: Time range: Lochkovian to Lochkovian (419.62 to 413.02 million years ago)
